item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-12 23:59
Institution: Univ. del SALENTO, Lecce
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-01 Statistica

The ecological transition poses a distributive challenge: air pollution and heat stress are often concentrated in areas characterized by socioeconomic vulnerability. Environmental Intelligence develops a Statistical AI framework to integrate Big Spatial Data from monitoring stations, satellites, climate reanalyses and administrative records. The aim is to estimate and predict exposure to PM2.5, NO₂ and heat stress, including in poorly monitored areas, and to analyse their association with socioeconomic vulnerability.

The objective of this research project is to develop new compatible and structure-preserving schemes for Hamiltonian PDE systems that originate from the SHTC / GENERIC frameworks.
